scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply findme-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply findme --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
